claims.source_quote_ar: جملة: «قال ... » لا محلّ لها استئناف بيانيّ
claims.claim_ar: استئناف بياني عبر صيغة القول «قَالَا» وانتقال إلى خطاب مباشر/دعاء يعتبر لفتة بلاغية (التبدّل إلى الكلام المباشر لتعزيز الحضور الصوتي للنصح والاعتراف).
claims.claim_en: A rhetorical shift (iltifat) introduced by the speech marker «قَالَا», moving into direct address/prayer — a stylistic turn that foregrounds the scene and intensifies the confession/prayer.

claims.claim_ar: صيغة دعاء متضَمرَة (تضرع وخفية) في «رَبَّنَا ...» تُضفي طابع الخشوع والرقة والتضرّع، فتُكثِر من التأثير العاطفي والندم.
claims.claim_en: A devotional/speech-style device: the prayer is expressed with secrecy and entreaty (tadarru' wa khafiyya), giving the supplication a tone of humility and pathos, enhancing emotional impact.

claims.claim_ar: توكيد بلاغي في «لَنَكُونَنَّ»: لام التوكيد مع نون التوكيد تُضفي قطعاً وحسمًا على نتيجة محتومة («لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الخاسرين»).
claims.claim_en: Emphatic repetition/confirmation: the lām of emphasis combined with the emphatic nūn in «لَنَكُونَنَّ» produces a forceful, decisive emphasis on the inevitable outcome ('we will certainly be among the losers').
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted source discusses the lām particle in grammatical/phonetic terms; applying it as the specific rhetorical label for this combined lām+ن warrant confirmation from classical rhetoric sources.

claims.claim_ar: مقابلة/توازي في الطلب بواسطة اتحاد الفعلين «تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا» — تكرار الطلب بفعْلين متوازيين يعمّقان حسّ الاستجداء ويضاعفان المطلب.
claims.claim_en: Parallelism (muaqabalah): the paired verbs «taghfir lana wa tarhamna» form a balanced double petition — the coordination of two verbs intensifies the plea and broadens its semantic scope.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited chunk treats grammatical coordination ('عطف على'); mapping that to the rhetorical category 'muaqabalah' (balanced verbal pairing) is plausible but should be verified against stylistic sources.

warnings: Source chunks provided are primarily grammatical/commentarial excerpts; some rhetorical labels (especially for emphasis devices) are inferred from grammatical discussion rather than explicit rhetorical exposition in the chunks.

Some device_subtype assignments (e.g., labelling the lām+nun emphatic form as a specific badi subtype) should be cross-checked against dedicated balagha sources (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir-balagha) for terminological alignment.
